categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of precious metal catalysts and chemical products, including palladium, platinum, ruthenium, rhodium, iridium, and gold-based catalysts. It also engages in non-precious metal catalyst development, catalyst application technology services, and recycling of used precious metal catalysts. The business covers fine chemicals, basic chemicals, environmental protection, new energy, and electronics sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced multi-phase and homogeneous catalyst preparation technologies, including precise control of active metal valence states and dispersion on carriers. It has developed proprietary catalytic synthesis technologies, continuous catalytic hydrogenation processes, and high-efficiency recycling of precious metals. The production involves fixed-bed reactors, catalyst carrier pretreatment, and activation through reduction techniques, with a focus on green, low-cost, and high-performance catalyst manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in pharmaceutical intermediates, chemical new materials, pesticides, dyes and pigments, chlor-alkali industry, environmental protection, and new energy sectors. The company serves over a thousand clients, including more than a hundred listed companies, with strategic partnerships with industry leaders. The markets are primarily domestic with some international sales, focusing on industries requiring high-performance catalysts for chemical synthesis and environmental applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production and R&D bases in Xi'an, Tongchuan, and Binzhou. It has a domestic market focus with limited overseas sales. The company is expanding capacity and market reach within China, particularly in Shaanxi province and surrounding regions, while also increasing international competitiveness through overseas market development.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the catalyst supply chain, including catalyst manufacturing, application technology services, and recycling of used catalysts. It procures raw precious metals and carriers, processes them into catalysts, and provides technical services to end-users in chemical production. It also recycles precious metals from used catalysts, closing the loop in the supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include green development, technological leadership, and innovation-driven growth. R&D focuses on catalyst preparation technologies, catalytic synthesis, precious metal recycling, continuous catalytic processes, and non-precious metal catalyst development. The company emphasizes import substitution, addressing key industry bottlenecks, and expanding into new fields such as hydrogen energy and environmental catalysis. Collaboration with universities and research institutes supports accelerated innovation and industrialization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of catalyst products, catalyst processing services (including toll processing with customer-supplied or company-advanced precious metals), and catalytic application technology services. The company prices products based on raw material costs, especially precious metal prices, plus processing and profit margins. It also earns government subsidies and investment income, but core revenue is product sales and related services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player and technology leader in precious metal catalysts for fine chemicals in China, with a strong market position and extensive customer base. It competes with international catalyst manufacturers but has achieved significant import substitution. The company is expanding into non-precious metal catalysts and new energy sectors to strengthen its competitive edge and industry leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.69 billion, a 5.53% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to lower precious metal prices affecting product pricing. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 92.6 million, down 17.95% year-over-year. Total assets grew 33.86% to RMB 2.05 billion, reflecting investments in new projects and inventory buildup. The company maintains steady growth with ongoing capacity expansion and R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-performance, cost-effective, and environmentally friendly catalysts with advanced preparation technologies that improve catalyst activity, selectivity, stability, and lifespan. It offers integrated solutions combining catalyst products, application technology services, and recycling, providing customers with tailored, green, and efficient catalytic processes. Its strong R&D capabilities and proprietary technologies enable import substitution and address critical industry challenges, delivering unique value in fine chemicals, basic chemicals, and emerging sectors.
